name: rate-limit-requests

error.message: Rate limit reached for requests. Please try again in 20s.

reason: transient throttling — backing off and retrying is the correct response

name: insufficient-quota

error.message: You exceeded your current quota, please check your plan and billing details.

reason: same HTTP status as a rate limit, but this is a billing/quota exhaustion — no amount of retrying helps until the account is topped up

name: server-error

error.message: The server had an error while processing your request. Sorry about that!

reason: generic upstream failure, transient by nature

name: service-unavailable

error.message: The engine is currently overloaded, please try again later.

reason: explicit overload signal, expected to clear on its own

name: invalid-api-key
reason: credentials are wrong; retrying sends the same bad key again

name: bad-request-file-format
reason: the request itself is malformed; retrying sends the same bad file again
